## Change and source

Describe the behavior change and source lineage. Identify any imported or generated files.

## Dependencies and configuration

List changed manifests/locks, shared contracts and nonsecret configuration requirements.

## Validation

List exact checks run and results. Explicitly list unrun checks and known gaps.

## Security and rollback

Confirm the reviewed diff contains no credentials or private runtime data. Explain deployment impact and rollback, if applicable.
